title: Balcony Fisheye
summary:
Last weekend, doors that are normally closed to the public were unlocked for the city's very popular Doors Open event, and one of the regular venues at the event was the city's somewhat ornate, historic, and very cozy Arts and Letters club. Its vault-ceilinged auditorium, captured with a wide angle lens wide enough to give a fisheye effect for the scene, appears rounded in this view from the balcony.
